label: FS.com GPON-ONU-34-20BI GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT built into an SFP module (SourcePhotonics SPS-34-24T-HP-TDFO ODM, Lantiq PEB98035 SoC, OpenWrt 14.07 on kernel 3.10.49, MIPS 34Kc at 400 MHz, SC/APC BOSA) that presents itself to the host router as an HSGMII Ethernet interface at 2.5 Gbit/s; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its TTL serial console (115200 8N1) or SSH.
